company.shortDescription: Verify Payments is the first "killer app" built on the Verify Reputation protocol.
company.description: Verify Payments is built on the Verify Reputation Protocol.Verify is a reputation protocol that tracks the transaction history of participants (buyers, sellers) and unlocks benefits for those with good reputation. Verify Payments enables businesses to connect with bank accounts across the largest banks in the GCC to enable efficient, fast payments directly from the source.
